invented.quote: The supply boat won't come back until spring.
invented.why: The brief only states the game is about seeing a lighthouse keeper's family through a winter, without mentioning a supply boat or when it returns.

invented.quote: The lamp has to burn every night.
invented.why: The brief does not mention a specific game mechanic or story rule requiring the lamp to burn every night.

invented.quote: Every session taught me something, and most of them changed something.
invented.why: The brief states that 140 playtest sessions were run, but does not state that most of them resulted in changes to the game.

invented.quote: Twenty-three players have rated it on BoardGameGeek so far. Their average is 8.1 out of 10.
invented.why: The brief refers only to 'the main board game ratings site' and an average rating of 8.1, without naming BoardGameGeek or specifying a 10-point scale.

invented.quote: I work full time and designed this game in the hours around that job.
invented.why: The brief states the creator works full time as a land surveyor, not when the game was designed or whether they worked that job during the entire design process.

invented.quote: The rest covers platform fees and payment processing.
invented.why: The brief does not state what the remaining ~$5,500 of the funding goal will be used for.

invented.quote: Printing doesn't depend on reaching a stretch goal.
invented.why: The brief does not mention stretch goals or whether the campaign has any.

invented.quote: If it falls short, there's no print run. The game stays a prototype that 60 people have played and nobody else can buy.
invented.why: The brief does not specify whether the campaign uses an all-or-nothing funding model or what the creator will do with the game if the campaign fails.

invented.quote: along with a winter at the edge of the sea
invented.why: The brief says the game is about a lighthouse keeper's family, not whether the lighthouse is on the sea as opposed to a lake or river.

invented.quote: Thank you for reading, and thank you to everyone who sat down at the table with me over the last three years.
invented.why: The brief states playtesting started 'since 2023' and does not specify the current year, so a duration of three years is not given.
